| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Sigma** `sigma` | 2 | 0.5 to 8 px | The width of the Gaussian profile across the vessel. The kernel ends at 3 sigma. |
| **Length** `length` | 9 | 1 to 41 px | How far the kernel reaches along the vessel. |
| **Directions** `orientations` | 12 | 1 to 24 | How many vessel directions to try, spread evenly over 180 degrees. |
| **Vessels are** `polarity` | Darker than the background | Darker than the background, Brighter than the background | Whether the lines to find are dark or bright. |
| **Output** `output` | Largest response | Largest response, Direction of the largest response | The strength of the best match, or the vessel direction in degrees. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Stretch to full range | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | Brightness only | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
